{{Quote|Hello again, Captain.|Agent Soganti|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Soganti''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Republic Customs Office]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], he was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], then in a middle of a [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|restoration effort]]. He investigated the activities of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Beryl Thorne]], but failed to find any solid evidence on her. Soganti approached another smuggler - the future [[Voidhound]] - with a goodwill offer to sell Thorne out. Instead, the smuggler informed Beryl that Soganti was after her, allowing her to flee. The smuggler later escaped Taris by slipping right past Soganti with the help of some forged documents.

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] Soganti was assigned to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] by the [[Republic Customs Office]] to watch for attempts to smuggle contraband on and off of the planet. His suspicious nature led him to regularly search [[Beryl Thorne]]'s warehouse, but he found no evidence of contraband.

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR dates">{{TOR_dates|1}} As the events on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] for the Smuggler, including the multiple encounters with Soganti, it can be inferred that they took place in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Soganti greeted a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] - later known as the [[Voidhound]] - of a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] upon their arrival at [[Olaris Spaceport]] and passed a firm warning to avoid smuggling any contraband. Soganti later encountered the Voidhound as he was leading a pair of customs agents on another fruitless raid of Thorne's warehouse. Soganti then became suspicious of the Voidhound and ordered surveillance on the captain's movements.

Soganti later approached the Voidhound after they returned to their ship and disembarked, demanding the captain admit how Thorne was smuggling relics off Taris, even offering a generous bribe in exchange for testimony. However, the Voidhound refused to say a word against Thorne. Defeated, Soganti was forced to leave, but not before reminding the Voidhound that no criminal escapes justice forever.
{{Endgame}}
